correctness.rationale: In this progression p−16 is divisible by 9. The independently written complete integer Eratosthenes sieve enumerated all primes in the progression 7≤p≤189954151 (879429 cases) and used exact prime-square marking for p−1, p−2, p−4, p−8, p−32. Exactly 21 primes fail all four first tests, and exactly one also fails p−32: 189954151. The same sieve confirms that boundary p is prime and p−64 is squarefree, so e(p)=6. The exhaustive bounded loop and squareful sieve have a direct proof of completeness, not a sampling argument; both supplied source verifiers and certificate were inspected, while the decisive fresh check is independent.
